title: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence
breadcrumb: Solutions > Workforce & Experience > Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence
meta_description: Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence — composed architecture, platform stack and the metric the program answers to.

blocks.x: How Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence runs when it is engineered for the enterprise: bounded scope per gate, platform evidence generated in-flight, and outcomes stated as deltas against the number we signed together.
The problem this solution exists for
Skills live in resumes and manager heads; workforce planning is headcount arithmetic; internal mobility blocked by invisible skills; learning spend unmeasured.
Our approach
We build the skills graph: HRIS/LMS/performance data unified to a taxonomy, role/skill gap analytics feeding hiring and mobility, learning pathways wired to gaps, and evidence of capability transfer.

blocks.x: Platform stack

The stack for Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence is assembled per estate, but the pattern is stable: one event spine, one governance plane, one decision layer — and no component without a named owner.
How it runs in an engagement

items: We measure the starting position and lock the baseline with your team — no build work begins before the number is agreed.
A bounded pilot on your real data, with the gate review scheduled before the first commit is written.
Runbooks, enablement and the control trail that let your teams operate it without us in the room.
Quarterly re-audits and a ranked backlog of the next decisions worth automating — value that accumulates on purpose.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

Before Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence starts, three things need to exist: a metric your board recognizes, data access under an approved path, and a named owner on each source system. The readiness check takes two weeks and says no when it should.
How a delivery runs

A delivery for Talent, Skills & Workforce Intelligence runs on rhythm, not ritual: the baseline is signed in the first weeks, evidence is generated as the work happens, and the gate at each stage has real stop authority. Programs that miss their evidence stop.
Outcomes we commit to

items: time-to-productivity is tracked weekly to your control owner; the number at gate three is the number finance sees
learning ROI carries the program: if the delta stalls, the gate redirects scope toward it before anything else

blocks.x: Proof

The measured delta and the method note are written up on the case page — anonymized by agreement, baseline audited.
